episode_row: MLB auth/login flap → failed cron + DM advising cookie re-capture; park_drag table stale

commits.subject: fix(auth): classify MLB auth/login failures; retry only outage shapes
commits.body:
2026-08-11 incident: MLB endpoints flapped; auth/login returned blank
HTTP 200s (~1-in-3 for a stretch) and 503s. The single-shot login in
fetch-contest-streak turned one blank 200 into a failed cron + a DM
advising cookie re-capture — a misdiagnosis (cookies were valid all day).

fetch_login_session now retries in-process (2s/4s doubling, numeric
Retry-After honored capped 30s) ONLY shapes that cannot be a rejection of
us: transport errors, 5xx, and zero-length 200 bodies. Non-empty non-JSON
200s (challenge-page shaped), non-object JSON, and 2xx!=200 raise
TransientAuthError immediately — no retry (kill-switch), no cookie advice.
429 raises RateLimitedLoginError ("back off", never "re-capture" — the
interactive recapture flow ADDS auth traffic). Other 4xx/3xx/missing-xSid
stay credential-shaped (cookie advice), now carrying the errors envelope
or body snippet for cron.log diagnosability. Malformed bodies (null body,
success/user non-dict) no longer escape as AttributeError past every
handler — that hole meant NO DM exactly when MLB served garbage.

fetch-contest-streak: distinct handlers + per-category DM cooldowns
(transient / rate_limited / actionable) so an outage DM cannot suppress a
later real cookie-death DM; stamps survive successful runs (a flap that
recovers and re-breaks stays throttled); legacy single-stamp records
migrate to ALL categories (pure legacy semantics, no double DM on
upgrade). Profile-stage 429 / 5xx / transport failures categorize as
rate_limited / transient as well.

check-pick-entered: attempts=2 (the */15 cron is the outer retry loop),
and minutes-to-cutoff is now net of monotonic fetch elapsed — never DM
"Fix it now" for an entry that locked mid-fetch; that no-DM path still
writes the "alerted" marker so the EOD pick_entry audit fires
(detected-and-unresolved, same semantics as the tier-exhausted branch).

leaderboard scrape: same three-way message split.

Two Codex review rounds (gpt-5.6-sol xhigh, full repo access): r1 found
the challenge-page retry hazard and the AttributeError alerting hole; r2
caught regressions in the r1 amendments (whitespace != empty, hostile
Retry-After values reaching time.sleep, the cutoff guard erasing the EOD
audit marker, success wiping cooldown stamps, legacy-migration order
dependence). All fixed test-first. Rejected with rationale: backoff
jitter (single low-volume client), is_session_valid contract change
(zero callers; documented), check-pick quiet-skip redesign (deliberate
v3 design).

Fast suite 1918 -> 1958, 0 fail.
